scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
DIRECTORIAL SCENE NOTE (PRODUCTION ONLY): Camera: Wide front three-quarter classroom view. Blocking: Roselyn by crystal, Midori among seated novices. Action: Roselyn introduces the lesson. Expression: Midori attentive; classmates mixed interest.
Setting:
Morning.
Interior of the first-year classroom.
Roselyn stands beside a large crystal mounted in an ornate brass stand. The students immediately recognize the apparatus.
(Roselyn: "TODAY'S LESSON CONCERNS MANA CAPACITY."
-> "ONE OF THE MOST IMPORTANT CONCEPTS EVERY MAGE MUST UNDERSTAND.")

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Although many students are excited, several students exchange bored glances.
One quietly sighs.
Another leans back in his chair.
They've clearly heard this lesson before.
(Student1: "MANA CAPACITY..."
-> "...AGAIN?")

scenes.heading: Scene 3 (This may require three subpanels to capture Midori looking from the crystal to lucia to the other students).
scenes.script:
Setting:
Midori notices those students’ lack of enthusiasm.
She looks from the crystal...
...to Roselyn...
...then back to the other students.
She is obviously curious.
No dialogue.

scenes.script:
Setting:
Roselyn smiles knowingly.
She has seen this reaction every year.
(Roselyn: "YES."

-> "YOU DO NOT.")


The classroom immediately becomes quieter.

Setting:
Several students sit a little straighter.
Some look excited.

(Zarleen: "WELL, WE HAVE OUR OWN CLASSES TO ATTEND. IT LOOKS LIKE YOU’LL BE OKAY FROM HERE ON OUT."
-> "WE’LL SEE YOU AT LUNCH TIME.")

(Midori: "THANK YOU FOR LOOKING OUT FOR ME.")

scenes.script:
Setting:
Lady Alena begins drawing mana from the crystal.
The crystal glows steadily.
The classroom watches politely.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Effects: Alena’s eye color switches instantaneously to fully saturated green. Camera: readable close-up with both eyes visible; no gradient or soft intermediate color.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Only a few seconds pass.
The student’s eyes change instantly from their normal color to a uniform, vivid green.
The crystal's meter barely moves.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Effects: Alena’s eye color switches instantaneously to fully saturated green. Camera: readable close-up with both eyes visible; no gradient or soft intermediate color.

scenes.heading: Scene 3
scenes.script:
Setting:
The student immediately removes her hand from the crystal.
Roselyn glances at the meter and makes a notation on her clipboard.
(Roselyn: "VERY GOOD."
-> "PLEASE RETURN TO YOUR SEAT.")

(Lady Alena: "THANK YOU, LADY ROSELYN.")

scenes.heading: Scene 4
scenes.script:
Setting:
The next student steps forward as Alena returns to her desk.
The class is only mildly interested.
Most of them have seen this before.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Effects: Alena’s eye color switches instantaneously to fully saturated green. Camera: readable close-up with both eyes visible; no gradient or soft intermediate color.

scenes.heading: Scene 5
scenes.script:
Setting:
A brief montage.
One student after another places a hand on the crystal.
Within a few seconds...
Each student's eyes turn green.
Roselyn records another result.
Then another.
Then another.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Effects: Alena’s eye color switches instantaneously to fully saturated green. Camera: readable close-up with both eyes visible; no gradient or soft intermediate color.

scenes.heading: Scene 6
scenes.script:
Setting:
Midori watches each demonstration with growing fascination.
She quietly compares the crystal...
...the students' eyes...
...and Roselyn's clipboard.
(Midori (thinking): "...EVERYONE IS DIFFERENT..."
-> "...BUT EVERYONE REACHES GREEN.")

scenes.script:
Setting:
Caption: "TWENTY SECONDS LATER."
Midori remains perfectly still, calmly drawing mana from the crystal.
Her eyes remain their normal color.
Several students begin shifting impatiently in their seats.
(Student1: "...HOW LONG IS THIS SUPPOSED TO TAKE?")

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Roselyn studies the mana discharge meter, now well beyond ordinary student readings.
The needle has moved farther than for any previous student.
She looks back at Midori.
Still no green.
Roselyn quietly lowers her clipboard.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Rising tension through progressively tighter shots of meter, crystal, and Roselyn; elapsed-time captions are lettering-overlay content. No new elapsed time or readings beyond script.

scenes.heading: Scene 3
scenes.script:
Setting:
Caption: "TWENTY-FIVE SECONDS LATER."
The meter approaches the top of its nominal high-capacity range, but Midori’s eyes are still brown.
The classroom has become noticeably quieter.
Students who had been whispering are now watching intently.
No dialog.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Rising tension through progressively tighter shots of meter, crystal, and Roselyn; elapsed-time captions are lettering-overlay content. No new elapsed time or readings beyond script.

(Buren: "WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?")

scenes.heading: Scene 5
scenes.script:
Setting:
Caption: "THIRTY-FIVE SECONDS LATER."
Roselyn glances toward the classroom door.
Roselyn calls a student from the front row and sends the student to find Lucia.
(Roselyn: "FETCH LADY LUCIA, THE MISTRESS OF INSTRUCTION, AND BRING HER TO CLASSROOM ONE."
-> "IMMEDIATELY.")

(Student1: "YES, LADY ROSELYN.")
The student hurries out to fetch Lucia.

scenes.heading: Scene 6
scenes.script:
Setting:
Caption: "NEARLY FORTY SECONDS LATER."
The meter reaches its maximum calibrated reading and pegs there. Midori’s eyes remain brown; the crystal is still supplying mana.
Midori continues absorbing mana.
The mana crystal begins to flicker.
For the first time...
Roselyn looks genuinely concerned.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Rising tension through progressively tighter shots of meter, crystal, and Roselyn; elapsed-time captions are lettering-overlay content. No new elapsed time or readings beyond script.

Setting:
Close on the crystal.
Midori still has her hand on it.
The meter remains pegged as the steady blue glow sputters and the crystal dims.
The classroom is completely silent.

The crystal is completely dark.

Setting:
The mana crystal is completely dark
Midori remains completely unaware.

The room is utterly silent.
No dialogue.

scenes.script:
Setting:
The classroom door opens.
Lucia, Mistress of Instruction, enters quickly in response to Roselyn’s summons.
She immediately notices the unusual silence.
Then she notices Roselyn’s expression and the pegged meter.
(Lucia: "LADY ROSELYN?" -> "WHAT HAPPENED?")

Setting:
Without taking her eyes off Midori, Roselyn quietly gestures toward the exhausted crystal and pegged meter.

-> "...AND SHE EXHAUSTED THE ENTIRE CRYSTAL.")

...to concern.

scenes.script:
Setting:
Lucia walks directly to the mana apparatus. Roselyn remains beside Midori.
She studies the meter, which is pegged at its maximum calibrated reading.
Then the crystal.
Then Midori's completely unchanged eyes.
No dialogue.

scenes.script:
Setting:
Close on Lucia.
For the first time in the series...
She looks genuinely puzzled.
(Lucia: "THE CLASSROOM CRYSTAL-DISCHARGE METER’S RANGE WAS FAR TOO LOW. HER EYES ARE STILL BROWN.")

dialogue: (Lucia: "THE CLASSROOM CRYSTAL-DISCHARGE METER’S RANGE WAS FAR TOO LOW. HER EYES ARE STILL BROWN.")

scenes.heading: Scene 6
scenes.script:
Setting:
Lucia turns to Roselyn.
(Lucia: "PLEASE SEND SOMEONE FOR LADY ELIANE. WE NEED THE MANA-CRYSTAL SPECIALIST.")
Roselyn calls a student to the door.
(Roselyn: "FIND LADY ELIANE AND ASK HER TO COME IMMEDIATELY.")
(Student1: "YES, LADY ROSELYN.")
The student runs to fetch Eliane. The depleted crystal remains dark; the class watches in silence.
It is completely exhausted.
Students lean forward in their seats.
Nobody whispers.
Nobody moves.
They simply watch.

Blocking: Midori touches crystal and keeps eyes open; Eliane adjusts meter range; Lucia observes. Do not imply Eliane is absorbing mana.

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
DIRECTORIAL SCENE NOTE (PRODUCTION ONLY): Camera: Wide laboratory establishing shot with entire workbench. Blocking: Midori at active crystal; Eliane by discharge meter; Lucia behind observation line.
Setting:
Blocking: Midori, Eliane, Lucia
The depleted classroom crystal remains disconnected on the workbench. Eliane sets the laboratory discharge meter to a much higher absolute-mana range.
She connects the laboratory crystal-discharge meter, with its range expanded but its personal color thresholds not yet calibrated, to a much larger crystal mounted in a reinforced brass frame.
The crystal is nearly three times the size of the one used in class.
Midori and Lucia watch closely.
No dialogue.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Midori, Eliane, Lucia
Eliane checks every connection and confirms the expanded measurement range on the apparatus.
She nods once, satisfied.
(Eliane: "THIS CRYSTAL CONTAINS CONSIDERABLY MORE MANA."
-> "IT SHOULD BE MORE THAN SUFFICIENT.")

scenes.heading: Scene 3
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Eliane, Midori, meter, Lucia
Midori stands beside the apparatus.
Midori places one hand on the crystal.
Eliane and Lucia stand on either side of the meter.
(Eliane: "WHENEVER YOU'RE READY.")
(Midori: "YES, LADY ELIANE.")

dialogue: (Eliane: "WHENEVER YOU'RE READY.")

scenes.heading: Scene 4
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Eliane, Midori, meter, Lucia
Midori keeps her eyes open so Eliane can observe the instant her eye color changes.
The large crystal begins glowing brightly as she starts drawing mana.
The meter immediately begins climbing.
Lucia watches the needle.
Eliane watches Midori's eyes.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Crystal Vault laboratory; establish workbench, larger laboratory crystals, discharge meter and observer positions. Blocking: Midori touches crystal and keeps eyes open; Eliane adjusts meter range; Lucia observes. Do not imply Eliane is absorbing mana.

scenes.heading: Scene 5
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Eliane, Midori, meter, Lucia
Several secs pass.
The meter continues climbing.
The crystal remains brilliantly illuminated.
Midori's eyes remain completely unchanged.
Lucia quietly frowns.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Crystal Vault laboratory; establish workbench, larger laboratory crystals, discharge meter and observer positions. Blocking: Midori touches crystal and keeps eyes open; Eliane adjusts meter range; Lucia observes. Do not imply Eliane is absorbing mana.

scenes.heading: Scene 6 (two or three sub panels)
scenes.script:
Setting:
Close on Eliane.
She glances from the steadily climbing meter...
...to Midori's unchanged eyes.
Her expression shifts from confidence...
...to growing uncertainty.


Eliane checks the needle and arbitrarily increases the instrument’s absolute measurement range once more. The needle settles below the upper stop. This is a range adjustment, not a personal color-threshold calibration.
(Eliane: "THAT KEEPS THE METER FROM PEGGING." -> "BUT WE CANNOT CALIBRATE HER COLOR THRESHOLDS UNTIL HER EYES CHANGE.")

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
Setting:
Eliane carefully disconnects the depleted crystal.
She places it beside the other exhausted crystal.
Then she walks to a locked storage cabinet.
Lucia watches silently.
No dialogue.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Eliane unlocks the cabinet with mana.
Inside rests an enormous crystal, nearly the size of Midori's torso.
It is mounted in a reinforced brass cradle.
Midori stares.
(Midori: "...I'VE NEVER SEEN ONE THAT LARGE.")
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Props: Track which laboratory crystal is exhausted and which is installed next; keep relative crystal sizes and positions consistent.
dialogue: (Midori: "...I'VE NEVER SEEN ONE THAT LARGE.")

scenes.heading: Scene 3
scenes.script:
Setting:
Eliane and Lucia carefully lift the crystal together and secure it to the laboratory discharge meter. Eliane expands the meter’s measurement range again.
The apparatus is obviously straining under its weight.
Eliane checks every connection twice.
(Eliane: "THIS CRYSTAL IS NORMALLY RESERVED FOR ADVANCED RESEARCH."
-> "IF THIS ISN'T SUFFICIENT...")

She doesn't finish the sentence.

scenes.heading: Scene 4

Setting:
Midori stands beside the apparatus.
She looks uncertain.
(Midori: "SHOULD I RETURN THE MANA FIRST?")
Eliane immediately shakes her head.
(Eliane: "NO."
-> "LEAVE EVERYTHING EXACTLY AS IT IS.")

Both instructors watch without blinking.
No dialogue.

script_source:
Setting:
Eliane and Lucia carefully lift the crystal together and secure it to the laboratory discharge meter. Eliane expands the meter’s measurement range again.
The apparatus is obviously straining under its weight.
Eliane checks every connection twice.
(Eliane: "THIS CRYSTAL IS NORMALLY RESERVED FOR ADVANCED RESEARCH."
-> "IF THIS ISN'T SUFFICIENT...")

She doesn't finish the sentence.
Setting:
Midori stands beside the apparatus.
She looks uncertain.
(Midori: "SHOULD I RETURN THE MANA FIRST?")
Eliane immediately shakes her head.
(Eliane: "NO."
-> "LEAVE EVERYTHING EXACTLY AS IT IS.")

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
Setting:
The enormous crystal continues glowing brilliantly.
Midori quietly continues absorbing mana.
The mana meter climbs steadily.
Her eyes remain their normal dark-brown color; the green threshold has not yet been reached.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Reserve largest panel for immediate uniform green-eye reveal. Sequence: eyes change, crystal runs dry, then Midori removes hand. Camera: do not obscure eyes at threshold.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Close on the crystal.
For nearly a full min it continues supplying mana.
Then...
Its brilliant glow begins to weaken.
Lucia slowly shakes her head in disbelief.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Reserve largest panel for immediate uniform green-eye reveal. Sequence: eyes change, crystal runs dry, then Midori removes hand. Camera: do not obscure eyes at threshold.

scenes.heading: Scene 3
scenes.script:
Setting:
The crystal flickers.
Once.
Twice.
Then...
As the last mana drains away, Midori’s eyes cross the green threshold and instantly become a uniform, vivid green. Then the crystal goes completely dark.
The room falls silent.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Reserve largest panel for immediate uniform green-eye reveal. Sequence: eyes change, crystal runs dry, then Midori removes hand. Camera: do not obscure eyes at threshold.

scenes.heading: Scene 4
scenes.script:
DIRECTORIAL SCENE NOTE (PRODUCTION ONLY): Camera: Extreme close-up on both of Midori’s eyes at instant of threshold. Effects: immediate uniform vivid green; no gradual transition.
Setting:
Midori turns toward Eliane, her eyes still open after the crystal goes dark.
Midori’s eyes are now uniformly green. She has kept her hand on the crystal until its final light disappeared.
With the crystal now completely dark, she removes her hand.
(Midori: "IS..."
-> "...THAT WHAT IT WAS SUPPOSED TO DO?")

scenes.heading: Scene 5
scenes.script:
Setting:
Eliane slowly walks toward Midori.
She studies her eyes for several long seconds.
Then gently smiles with obvious relief.
(Eliane: "YES."
-> "EXACTLY.")

dialogue:

-> "EXACTLY.")

scenes.heading: Scene 6
scenes.script:
Setting:
Wide shot of the Crystal Vault.
Three completely depleted mana crystals now sit on the workbench.
Lucia quietly stares at them.
Eliane looks toward Midori.
Neither woman speaks.
The magnitude of what has just happened is still sinking in.

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
DIRECTORIAL SCENE NOTE (PRODUCTION ONLY): Camera: Medium shot showing Eliane selecting wearable gauge from cabinet; distinguish it from bench discharge meter.
Setting:
Eliane walks to a nearby cabinet filled with precision instruments.
She opens a shallow drawer containing several delicate brass mechanisms.
Lucia watches with curiosity.
No dialogue.
scenes.camera: DIRECTORIAL SCENE NOTE (PRODUCTION ONLY): Camera: Medium shot showing Eliane selecting wearable gauge from cabinet; distinguish it from bench discharge meter.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Props: Personal gauge introduced as a new wearable instrument with numbered absolute-mana graduations and colored bands; green threshold measured, yellow/orange provisional.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Eliane removes a small circular instrument, about the size of a pocket watch.
Its face contains a finely graduated, numbered scale indicating absolute mana quantity and a single needle.
The scale also has colored threshold markings; only the green threshold can currently be calibrated for Midori.
The yellow and orange bands are provisional until those thresholds can be observed.
Midori studies it curiously.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Props: Personal gauge introduced as a new wearable instrument with numbered absolute-mana graduations and colored bands; green threshold measured, yellow/orange provisional.

scenes.heading: Scene 3
scenes.script:
Setting:
Eliane places the instrument on the workbench.
(Eliane: "A PERSONAL MANA GAUGE. IT MEASURES THE ABSOLUTE MANA YOU CURRENTLY CONTAIN."
-> "RESEARCHERS SOMETIMES USE THEM DURING LONG-TERM EXPERIMENTS. THE SCALE AND COLOR BANDS MUST BE CALIBRATED FOR EACH WEARER.")
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Props: Personal gauge introduced as a new wearable instrument with numbered absolute-mana graduations and colored bands; green threshold measured, yellow/orange provisional.
dialogue:
(Eliane: "A PERSONAL MANA GAUGE. IT MEASURES THE ABSOLUTE MANA YOU CURRENTLY CONTAIN."
-> "RESEARCHERS SOMETIMES USE THEM DURING LONG-TERM EXPERIMENTS. THE SCALE AND COLOR BANDS MUST BE CALIBRATED FOR EACH WEARER.")

scenes.heading: Scene 4
scenes.script:
Setting:
Using the observed green-eye threshold, Eliane calibrates the personal gauge specifically for Midori. Higher color thresholds remain provisional. She closes the case and fastens it to a leather belt clip.
She hands it to Midori.
(Eliane: "WEAR IT ON YOUR BELT."
-> "IT WILL INDICATE YOUR ABSOLUTE MANA LEVEL.")
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Props: Personal gauge introduced as a new wearable instrument with numbered absolute-mana graduations and colored bands; green threshold measured, yellow/orange provisional.
dialogue:
(Eliane: "WEAR IT ON YOUR BELT."
-> "IT WILL INDICATE YOUR ABSOLUTE MANA LEVEL.")

scenes.heading: Scene 5
scenes.script:
Setting:
Midori clips the small gauge onto her belt.
She looks down at it.
The needle registers Midori’s current absolute stored mana in her individually calibrated green band, far below the gauge maximum.
It remains steady.
(Midori: "...IS IT WORKING?")
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Props: Personal gauge introduced as a new wearable instrument with numbered absolute-mana graduations and colored bands; green threshold measured, yellow/orange provisional.
dialogue: (Midori: "...IS IT WORKING?")

scenes.heading: Scene 6
scenes.script:
Setting:
Eliane and Lucia both look at the gauge.
Neither speaks for a moment.
Finally—
(Eliane: "PERFECTLY."
-> "I BELIEVE THAT'S GOING TO BECOME VERY IMPORTANT.")

Lucia quietly nods in agreement.

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
Setting:
A knock at the Crystal Vault door.
Before anyone answers...
The door slides open.
A professor with long, very curly white hair enters carrying an armful of books, several rolled charts, and a steaming cup of tea balanced precariously on top.
His spectacles are perched on his forehead, though he is obviously searching for them.
(Brienmay: "ELIANE?"
-> "HAVE YOU SEEN MY GLASSES?")

-> "HAVE YOU SEEN MY GLASSES?")

scenes.script:
Setting:
Eliane looks at him for a long moment.
Then quietly points upward.
No dialogue.

scenes.heading: Scene 4
scenes.script:
Setting:
Brienmay walks past a cluttered laboratory workbench occupying one corner of the Crystal Vault.
The bench is covered with astronomy charts, notebooks, crystal samples, brass instruments, beakers, and flasks. Brienmay sets the steaming cup of tea he carried into the Crystal Vault on the bench before examining the crystals. There is only one cup.
Everything looks as though he simply walked away in the middle of several experiments.
Eliane notices Midori looking at the bench.
(Eliane: "PROFESSOR BRIENMAY CONDUCTS MUCH OF HIS CRYSTAL RESEARCH HERE."
-> "I KEEP ASKING HIM TO ORGANIZE IT.")

(Brienmay: "...INTERESTING."
-> "WHO EMPTIED THESE?")

Not her black hair.

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
Setting:
Brienmay continues examining one of the depleted mana crystals.
Without looking up, he wanders toward a cluttered laboratory bench occupying one corner of the Crystal Vault.
The workbench is covered with notebooks, crystal samples, brass instruments, flasks, beakers, and a steaming cup of tea.
Everything appears to have been left exactly where Brienmay abandoned it earlier that morning.
No dialogue.

PANEL CAMERA/BLOCKING (PRODUCTION ONLY): Brienmay’s hand takes the flask while the teacup stays on the same cluttered bench. Eliane slides valuable crystals away; Lucia sees her action. Keep the depleted crystal safely in Brienmay’s other hand.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Blocking: Brienmay studies depleted crystal; Eliane retains authority over apparatus. Camera: close-up on his observation rather than ungrounded new experiments.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Still studying the crystal, Brienmay absent-mindedly reaches toward the workbench.
Without looking...
His hand closes around a glass flask instead of his teacup.
Eliane notices immediately.
She quietly slides several valuable mana crystals farther down the bench.

scenes.script:
Setting:
The classroom crystal is now fully recharged, brilliantly illuminated with its normal internal mana glow.
Midori moves to a depleted laboratory crystal and begins returning some mana.
The second laboratory crystal remains depleted nearby.
Lucia watches carefully.
(Lucia: "THE CLASSROOM CRYSTAL IS READY FOR ROSELYN’S NEXT LESSON. ONLY PARTIALLY RECHARGE THIS LABORATORY CRYSTAL."

scenes.heading: Scene 5 (may require multiple subpanels)
scenes.script:
Setting:
Midori stops recharging the first laboratory crystal while it is still partially depleted, retaining a reserve for her own classes.
The classroom crystal is fully charged; a laboratory crystal remains partially depleted.
The second laboratory crystal remains completely depleted.
Midori withdraws her hand.
Her eyes have returned to their normal dark-brown color.
She glances down at the mana gauge at her waist. Its needle has fallen below the green threshold into the bottom, normal-eye-color range.
The gauge indicates the absolute mana she has retained for magic classes.
Eliane looks satisfied.
Brienmay, meanwhile, has already become fascinated by what just happened.
No dialogue.

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
DIRECTORIAL SCENE NOTE (PRODUCTION ONLY): Camera: Wide quiet classroom with empty student seats and approval letter. Blocking: Roselyn by desk, Midori standing before her; hold relief reaction.
Setting: Later that afternoon, Roselyn's homeroom classroom, after the other students depart. A written notice bearing Headmistress Ashire's authorization rests on Roselyn's desk.
(Roselyn: "LADY MIDORI. HOW ARE YOU FEELING?")
(Midori: "VERY WELL, LADY ROSELYN." -> "LADY ELIANE SAID NOTHING WAS WRONG WITH ME.")
Roselyn shows Midori Ashire’s written approval.
(Roselyn: "HEADMISTRESS ASHIRE HAS APPROVED YOUR ENROLLMENT.")
(Midori: "THANK YOU, LADY ROSELYN!")
Hold on Midori’s visible relief as she reads Ashire’s written approval. Roselyn smiles and gestures toward a chair. Give this reaction breathing room; the approval arrived after the laboratory investigation.

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
Setting:
On another Academy day, at lunchtime.
The Academy dining hall is bustling with students eating lunch and talking with friends.
Midori carries a lunch tray while following Adnil, Naandeen, and Zarleen toward an empty table.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Lunch on a different Academy day. Blocking: companions occupy dining table; do not suggest this is first-day lunch. Props: Midori’s own wooden chopsticks.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Adnil, Midori, Naandeen, Zarleen.
The four girls sit together.
Midori quietly sets her tray down.
She reaches into a small cloth pouch hanging from her belt.
Adnil watches curiously.
(Adnil: "...WHAT'S THAT?")
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Lunch on a different Academy day. Blocking: companions occupy dining table; do not suggest this is first-day lunch. Props: Midori’s own wooden chopsticks.

scenes.script:
Setting:
Close on Midori
Midori smiles.
She removes a neatly wrapped pair of wooden chopsticks.
(Midori: "MY CHOPSTICKS."
-> "LADY SERAPHINE MADE THEM FOR ME.")

scenes.script:
Setting:

Adnil watches Midori effortlessly pick up vegetables, rice, and small pieces of fish.

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
DIRECTORIAL SCENE NOTE (PRODUCTION ONLY): Camera: Establish Brienmay’s approach to occupied dining table, then cut to chopsticks close-up.
Setting:
Blocking: Brienmay, Adnil, Midori, Naandeen, Zarleen
Before anyone can answer...
A familiar voice drifts past the table.
(Brienmay: "AN EXCELLENT QUESTION.")
The four girls look up.
Brienmay is walking through the dining hall carrying a tray piled much higher than it should be.
Books are balanced on top of it.
His spectacles are once again perched on his forehead.

scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Close on Brienmay, Midori, with Adnil (on the left) and Naandeen/Zarleen (on the right) just outside the panel (no huge gap between Adnil/Brienmay or Midori/Naandeen).

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Adnil, Brienmay, Midori, Naandeen, Zarleen
Brienmay calmly continues eating with Midori's chopsticks as though nothing unusual has happened.
Midori watches him curiously.
Adnil is trying very hard not to laugh.
No dialogue.

scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Adnil, Brienmay, Midori, Naandeen, Zarleen
Brienmay finishes one bite.
He thoughtfully hands the chopsticks back to Midori.
(Brienmay: "REMARKABLE DESIGN."
-> "WHO INVENTED THEM?")

scenes.heading: Scene 3
scenes.script:
Setting:
Close on Brienmay and Midori
Midori accepts them with both hands.
(Midori: "I DON'T KNOW."
-> "EVERYONE USED THEM WHERE I CAME FROM.")

Brienmay nods thoughtfully.
He immediately writes a note in a small notebook.

scenes.heading: Scene 4
scenes.script:
Setting:
Close on Brienmay and Midori
Midori looks puzzled.
(Midori: "PROFESSOR..."
-> "...WHY WERE YOU WRITING THAT DOWN?")
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Action: Brienmay eats successfully with chopsticks; pace reaction shots after the physical payoff. Preserve continuity of who owns/holds utensils.
dialogue:
(Midori: "PROFESSOR..."
-> "...WHY WERE YOU WRITING THAT DOWN?")

scenes.heading: Scene 5
scenes.script:
Setting:
Close on Brienmay and Midori
Brienmay doesn't even look up from the notebook.
(Brienmay: "GOOD IDEAS SHOULD NEVER BE TRUSTED TO MEMORY."
-> "ONE FORGETS THINGS.")

He absent-mindedly reaches toward his forehead...
Finds his glasses there...
And continues writing.

scenes.heading: Scene 6
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Adnil, Brienmay, Midori, Naandeen, Zarleen
Brienmay stands, balancing his tray, books, notebook, and now several hastily sketched drawings of chopsticks.
He smiles at Midori.
(Brienmay: "THANK YOU, LADY MIDORI."
-> "YOU'VE GIVEN ME SOMETHING INTERESTING TO THINK ABOUT.")

He walks away.

scenes.heading: Scene 7
scenes.script:
Three steps later...
He walks directly into a stone pillar.
THUNK
Brienmay politely bows to the pillar.
(Brienmay: "...MY APOLOGIES.")

scenes.heading: Scene 8
scenes.script:
Without another word, he continues walking.
The four girls watch him disappear.
Adnil finally bursts into laughter.

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Zarleen, Naandeen, Adnil, Midori
On a subsequent afternoon, between classes.
Between classes, students from several Academy levels fill the corridor, leaving their separate classrooms.
Midori meets Adnil, Naandeen, and Zarleen in the busy Academy corridor after their separate lessons. The four walk together.
A mana-operated classroom door slides shut nearby as students emerge from different rooms.
Sound: Whoooosh

Setting:
Blocking: Zarleen, Naandeen, Adnil, Midori
The girls continue talking as they walk.
Midori becomes absorbed in the conversation.
Without thinking...
She walks directly into the next closed door.
THUNK

Midori rubs her forehead.
She looks at the perfectly innocent door.
(Midori: "...OH.")

(Adnil: "YOU FORGOT AGAIN!")

Setting:
Close on Midori and the door.
Midori blushes.

The door silently slides open.
Sound: Whoooosh
(Midori: "I REMEMBERED..."
-> "...JUST A LITTLE TOO LATE.")

Setting:

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
Setting:
Brienmay continues writing on the board.
The class copies his notes.
Midori carefully finishes writing the definition of a "sec."
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Action: Maintain cause and effect of apparatus failure; soot, spectacles, damaged equipment carry into next scene. Brienmay remains academically capable.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Brienmay turns back toward the demonstration table.
A small glass flask sits over a blue mana flame.
He absent-mindedly increases the heat.
(Brienmay: "OBSERVE CAREFULLY."
-> "THE SOLUTION SHOULD BE HEATED FOR EXACTLY TEN SECS.")

-> "THE SOLUTION SHOULD BE HEATED FOR EXACTLY TEN SECS.")

scenes.heading: Scene 3
scenes.script:
Setting:
Still talking to the class...
Brienmay forgets about the flask completely.
He begins sketching a diagram on the board instead.
The mana flame continues heating the flask.
Midori notices.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Action: Maintain cause and effect of apparatus failure; soot, spectacles, damaged equipment carry into next scene. Brienmay remains academically capable.

scenes.heading: Scene 4
scenes.script:
Setting:
Midori timidly raises her hand.
(Midori: "PROFESSOR...")
Brienmay continues writing.
He doesn't hear her.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Action: Maintain cause and effect of apparatus failure; soot, spectacles, damaged equipment carry into next scene. Brienmay remains academically capable.
dialogue: (Midori: "PROFESSOR...")

scenes.heading: Scene 5
scenes.script:
Setting:
The liquid inside the flask begins bubbling violently.
Several students quietly notice.
None of them move.
Kenee casually rests his chin in his hand.
Beli calmly closes her notebook.
Buren quietly scoots his chair back a few inches.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Action: Maintain cause and effect of apparatus failure; soot, spectacles, damaged equipment carry into next scene. Brienmay remains academically capable.

scenes.heading: Scene 6
scenes.script:
Setting:
FWOOM!
The flask explodes in a harmless cloud of smoke.
When the smoke clears...
Brienmay is standing exactly where he was.
Covered in soot.
His curly white hair is once again sticking straight outward.
The students continue taking notes as though nothing unusual has happened.
(Brienmay: "...INTERESTING."
-> "...PERHAPS NINE SECS NEXT TIME.")

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
DIRECTORIAL SCENE NOTE (PRODUCTION ONLY): Camera: Four-character walking shot with Midori, Beli, Kenee and Buren; preserve left-to-right direction.
Setting: Brienmay’s lesson has ended. Students gather their books and walk into the corridor. Midori packs away her notes.

Setting:
Midori, Beli, Kenee, Buren are not in the frame.
A lavatory door slowly opens.

Professor Brienmay steps out.
His robes are blackened with soot.
His curly white hair is sticking straight upward.
He looks thoughtfully back into the lavatory.
No dialogue.

-> "I DON'T BELIEVE THAT HAS EVER HAPPENED BEFORE.")

He begins making notes in his notebook while still standing in the doorway.

scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Midori, Beli, Kenee, Buren, Brienmay

A long silence.
Everyone watches Brienmay.
Finally...
Buren quietly looks toward Midori.
(Buren: "...PERHAPS..."
-> "...YOU SHOULD TEACH HIM THE FLUSHING SPELL.")

Even Brienmay looks up from his notebook and nods thoughtfully.
(Brienmay: "THAT MIGHT ACTUALLY BE HELPFUL.")
Midori smiles politely.
(Midori: "I'D BE HAPPY TO, PROFESSOR.")

PRIVATE STUDY CONTINUITY (PRODUCTION ONLY): Roselyn’s Academy study is a modest, quiet faculty room with a recurring desk/table, chairs, books, writing tablets, and windows. script_source:
Setting:
Blocking: Midori, Beli, Kenee, Buren, Brienmay

A long silence.
Everyone watches Brienmay.
Finally...
Buren quietly looks toward Midori.
(Buren: "...PERHAPS..."
-> "...YOU SHOULD TEACH HIM THE FLUSHING SPELL.")

Even Brienmay looks up from his notebook and nods thoughtfully.
(Brienmay: "THAT MIGHT ACTUALLY BE HELPFUL.")
Midori smiles politely.
(Midori: "I'D BE HAPPY TO, PROFESSOR.")

PRIVATE STUDY CONTINUITY (PRODUCTION ONLY): Roselyn’s Academy study is a modest, quiet faculty room with a recurring desk/table, chairs, books, writing tablets, and windows. scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
Setting:
Several weeks later.
Interior of the Academy library.
Rows of books fill the room.
Students study quietly at long wooden tables.
Midori sits with a beginner's reading text, carefully sounding out unfamiliar words.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Library after time passage. Props: beginner material used for vocabulary review, not evidence Midori has lost literacy.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Across the room, Buren notices Midori reading.
He quietly nudges Beli.
(Buren: "SHE'S STILL USING FIRST-YEAR READERS."
-> "I TOLD YOU.")

Beli looks toward Midori but says nothing.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Library after time passage. Props: beginner material used for vocabulary review, not evidence Midori has lost literacy.
dialogue:
(Buren: "SHE'S STILL USING FIRST-YEAR READERS."
-> "I TOLD YOU.")

scenes.heading: Scene 3
scenes.script:
Setting:
Professor Brienmay walks through the library carrying a stack of books nearly as tall as he is.
He notices Midori.
Without saying anything...
He stops beside her table.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Library after time passage. Props: beginner material used for vocabulary review, not evidence Midori has lost literacy.

scenes.heading: Scene 4
scenes.script:
Setting:
Brienmay gently lifts the beginner's reader from the table.
He replaces it with a much thicker, far more advanced book.
Midori looks up in surprise.
(Midori: "PROFESSOR?")
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Library after time passage. Props: beginner material used for vocabulary review, not evidence Midori has lost literacy.
dialogue: (Midori: "PROFESSOR?")

scenes.heading: Scene 5
scenes.script:
Setting:
Brienmay casually flips open the larger book to a marked page.
(Brienmay: "READ THIS.")
Midori looks down at the page.
Her expression becomes serious.
She begins reading aloud slowly and carefully.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Library after time passage. Props: beginner material used for vocabulary review, not evidence Midori has lost literacy.
dialogue: (Brienmay: "READ THIS.")

scenes.heading: Scene 6
scenes.script:
Setting:
Across the library...
Buren watches with a faint smirk.
He quietly folds his arms.
(Buren: "...THAT SHOULD END THIS QUICKLY.")
Beli looks uncertain.
No dialogue.

Setting:
Close on the open book.
The page is filled with dense Zoran script.
Midori quietly begins reading.
She stumbles over several unfamiliar words.
No dialogue.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Brienmay patiently waits.
He doesn't interrupt.
Midori pauses...
Takes a breath...
Then starts the sentence again.
This time she reads it correctly.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Blocking: Brienmay and Midori at same open book; book he misplaces must be visibly nearby. Direction: gentle trust beat, not a new threat.

Setting:

Buren folds his arms.
He is clearly expecting Midori to give up.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Blocking: Brienmay and Midori at same open book; book he misplaces must be visibly nearby. Direction: gentle trust beat, not a new threat.

Midori reaches the end of the passage.

-> "THERE WERE THREE WORDS I DIDN'T RECOGNIZE.")

scenes.heading: Scene 5
scenes.script:
Setting:
Brienmay smiles.
Not proudly.
Simply matter-of-factly.
(Brienmay: "EXCELLENT."
-> "WE'LL BEGIN WITH THOSE THREE WORDS.")

He opens the book again.
Brienmay looks around for the book he has just opened, momentarily forgetting it is beneath his hand. Midori gently points to it.
(Brienmay: "AH, THERE IT IS." -> "THANK YOU, LADY MIDORI.")
He returns immediately to explaining the unfamiliar words.
(Midori (thinking): "HE REALLY DOES WANT ME TO LEARN." -> "AND HE HAS QUITE ENOUGH PROBLEMS OF HIS OWN.")
Brienmay points to the first unfamiliar word.

Beli notices the expression on her brother's face.
Neither speaks.

Setting:
Midori hesitates.
She looks down at her notes from the library.
Then slowly raises her hand.
The bully group immediately notices.
No dialogue.

scenes.script:
Setting:
Brienmay smiles faintly.
(Brienmay: "YES, LADY MIDORI?")
(Midori: "BECAUSE REPEATED CHARGING AND DISCHARGING SLOWLY CHANGES THE CRYSTAL'S INTERNAL MANA PATHWAYS..."
-> "...MAKING THEM LESS EFFICIENT AT STORING MANA.")

The classroom turns toward her in surprise.

Setting:

scenes.heading: Scene 4
scenes.script:
Setting:
Behind them...

-> "WE'LL DISCUSS THE NEXT CHAPTER TOMORROW.")

(Midori: "THANK YOU, PROFESSOR.")

scenes.heading: Scene 5
scenes.script:
Setting:
Buren glances back over his shoulder.
He sees Brienmay handing Midori the thick book.
His expression softens only slightly. For a moment, he looks genuinely uncertain; then he sets his jaw, unwilling to admit what he has seen.
(Buren: "...SEE?"
-> "HE'S HELPING HER."
-> "OF COURSE SHE'D KNOW THE ANSWER.")

scenes.heading: Scene 6
scenes.script:
Setting:
Beli looks back toward Midori.
Midori smiles as she carefully places the heavy book into her satchel.
Beli says nothing.
But for the first time...
She isn't entirely convinced by her brother's explanation.

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
Setting:
Narration: "SEVERAL MONS LATER."
An outdoor magic practice field.
Students stand in a line facing identical stone practice targets.
Celeste observes from the side.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Practical-magic instruction after elapsed mons. Blocking: Celeste is female and controls class exercise. Camera: establish targets and students’ firing positions.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
One student casts a Fire spell.
A large fireball slams into the target.
The stone blackens.
Several students nod approvingly.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Practical-magic instruction after elapsed mons. Blocking: Celeste is female and controls class exercise. Camera: establish targets and students’ firing positions.

scenes.heading: Scene 3
scenes.script:
Setting:
Midori steps forward.
She quietly raises one hand.
A much smaller flame leaves her fingertips.
It strikes the center of the target.
Only the center blackens.
The surrounding stone remains untouched.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Practical-magic instruction after elapsed mons. Blocking: Celeste is female and controls class exercise. Camera: establish targets and students’ firing positions.

scenes.heading: Scene 4
scenes.script:
Setting:
Several students exchange amused looks.
(Student1: "...THAT'S ALL?")
(Student2: "SHE BARELY CAST ANYTHING.")
Buren folds his arms with a faint smirk.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Practical-magic instruction after elapsed mons. Blocking: Celeste is female and controls class exercise. Camera: establish targets and students’ firing positions.
dialogue: (Student1: "...THAT'S ALL?")
(Student2: "SHE BARELY CAST ANYTHING.")

scenes.heading: Scene 5
scenes.script:
Setting:
Celeste walks to the target.
She kneels beside it for a closer look.
Her expression changes almost imperceptibly.
She quietly makes a note on her clipboard.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Practical-magic instruction after elapsed mons. Blocking: Celeste is female and controls class exercise. Camera: establish targets and students’ firing positions.

She looks uncertain, glancing toward Celeste’s clipboard.
No dialogue.

Setting:
Late afternoon.
A quiet garden on the Academy grounds.
Midori sits alone beneath a large tree, reading the advanced book Brienmay loaned her.
Students occasionally walk past in the background.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Later Academy day. Camera: transitional framing to avoid implying immediate continuation of practical lesson.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Adnil approaches carrying two cups of tea.
She quietly sits beside Midori.
She waits until Midori finishes the sentence she is reading before speaking.
(Adnil: "MIND IF I JOIN YOU?")
(Midori: "OF COURSE NOT.")

Adnil hands one cup to Midori.

No dialogue.

Adnil glances toward Midori.
(Adnil: "WHAT ARE YOU THINKING ABOUT?")

Midori closes the book and rests it on her lap.

Setting:
A montage panel.
Early autumn.
Midori walks across the Academy grounds carrying several books.
As she passes another group of students...
One of them smiles and waves.
Midori smiles and waves back.
No dialogue.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Another montage panel.
Inside a classroom.
Midori carefully copies notes onto a writing tablet.
Her handwriting is now elegant and confident.
Roselyn, Midori’s homeroom teacher, walks past her desk.
She glances down.
A faint smile appears.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Montage panels must show distinct moments over time, not the same class repeated. Keep character appearance and season changes coherent.

scenes.heading: Scene 3
scenes.script:
Setting:
Another montage panel.
Outdoor practice grounds.
Midori successfully casts a simple Fire spell.
This time it strikes exactly where intended.
Celeste quietly marks something on her clipboard.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Montage panels must show distinct moments over time, not the same class repeated. Keep character appearance and season changes coherent.

scenes.heading: Scene 4
scenes.script:
Setting:
Another montage panel.
Academy library.
Midori returns the advanced book to Brienmay.
He casually hands her an even thicker one.
Neither says a word.
Midori smiles.
Brienmay is already reading another book.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Montage panels must show distinct moments over time, not the same class repeated. Keep character appearance and season changes coherent.

scenes.heading: Scene 5
scenes.script:
Setting:
Another montage panel.
Academy corridor.
Midori approaches a mana-operated door.
Without thinking...
She instinctively places a little mana into it.
The door slides open smoothly.
She walks through without breaking stride.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Montage panels must show distinct moments over time, not the same class repeated. Keep character appearance and season changes coherent.

scenes.heading: Scene 6
scenes.script:
Setting:
Wide exterior shot of the Academy.
Leaves begin changing color.
Students move confidently between buildings.
Narration:
"THE MONS PASSED QUICKLY."

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Midori, Adnil, Naandeen, Zarleen
Later that evening.
The four roommates sit around the common table in their dorm room. Qualification examinations are held across all Academy levels during the same period; many foundational subjects are tested in common to confirm retention.
The table has disappeared beneath stacks of books, notebooks, maps, and loose pages.
Naandeen sits at the head of the table.
Adnil slumps dramatically over a history book.
Zarleen has a military tactics text open beside a history book.
Midori quietly organizes her notes.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Props: Keep books and notes in fixed places across study-session panels. Lighting: evening, readable and warm.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Midori, Adnil, Naandeen, Zarleen
Naandeen points to a map of the First Demon War.
(Naandeen: "LET'S BEGIN WITH THE WESTERN CAMPAIGN."
-> "WHO COMMANDED THE SECOND ARMY?")

Adnil immediately looks at the ceiling.
Zarleen studies the map.
Midori quietly thinks.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Props: Keep books and notes in fixed places across study-session panels. Lighting: evening, readable and warm.
dialogue:
(Naandeen: "LET'S BEGIN WITH THE WESTERN CAMPAIGN."
-> "WHO COMMANDED THE SECOND ARMY?")

scenes.heading: Scene 3
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Midori, Adnil, Naandeen, Zarleen
Midori raises her hand slightly.
(Midori: "GENERAL ASTER.")
Naandeen nods.
(Naandeen: "CORRECT.")
Adnil slowly turns toward Midori.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Props: Keep books and notes in fixed places across study-session panels. Lighting: evening, readable and warm.
dialogue: (Midori: "GENERAL ASTER.")
(Naandeen: "CORRECT.")

scenes.heading: Scene 4
scenes.script:
Setting:
Naandeen asks another question.
(Naandeen: "WHY WAS THE WESTERN PASS ABANDONED?")
Midori answers almost immediately.
(Midori: "THE SUPPLY LINES BECAME IMPOSSIBLE TO DEFEND.")

(Naandeen: "CORRECT.")

scenes.script:
Setting:
Morning.
The first-year classroom.
The students file into the room carrying books, notes, and far too little sleep.
Beli yawns.
Kenee looks exhausted.
Midori appears perfectly alert.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Classroom on following morning. Camera: establish Brienmay, papers, students; preserve absent-minded comedy.

scenes.heading: Scene 2
scenes.script:
Setting:
Brienmay enters carrying a stack of examination papers.
The class immediately becomes quiet.
He begins sorting the papers on his desk.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Classroom on following morning. Camera: establish Brienmay, papers, students; preserve absent-minded comedy.

scenes.heading: Scene 3
scenes.script:
Setting:
Brienmay pauses.
He looks down at the stack in his hands.
His expression changes.
(Brienmay: "...OH.")
The class watches him nervously.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Classroom on following morning. Camera: establish Brienmay, papers, students; preserve absent-minded comedy.
dialogue: (Brienmay: "...OH.")

scenes.heading: Scene 4
scenes.script:
Setting:
Brienmay flips through the papers.
His eyes widen slightly.
(Brienmay: "THESE APPEAR TO BE..."
-> "...LAST YUR'S QUALIFICATION EXAMINATION.")

The classroom collectively groans.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Classroom on following morning. Camera: establish Brienmay, papers, students; preserve absent-minded comedy.
dialogue:
(Brienmay: "THESE APPEAR TO BE..."
-> "...LAST YUR'S QUALIFICATION EXAMINATION.")

scenes.heading: Scene 5
scenes.script:
Setting:
Brienmay continues looking through the papers.
Completely serious.
(Brienmay: "I DO APOLOGIZE."
-> "I MAY HAVE BROUGHT THE WRONG SET.")

He reaches into his satchel for another stack.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Setting: Classroom on following morning. Camera: establish Brienmay, papers, students; preserve absent-minded comedy.
dialogue:
(Brienmay: "I DO APOLOGIZE."
-> "I MAY HAVE BROUGHT THE WRONG SET.")

scenes.heading: Scene 6
scenes.script:
Setting:
Brienmay freezes.
He slowly compares the two stacks.
Then looks up at the class.
(Brienmay: "...I MAY ALSO HAVE WRITTEN THIS YUR'S EXAMINATION.")
A long silence.
Every student stares at him.

scenes.heading: Scene 1
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Zarleen, Naandeen, Adnil, Midori
Morning.
The Academy dormitory.
The first rays of sunlight shine through the windows.
The four roommates quietly gather their books and satchels.
Unlike every other morning...
No one is talking.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Quiet final procession toward examinations; use wide closing panel for anticipation. Do not show examination outcomes or add a chapter title/folio.

scenes.heading: Scene 2 (separate panels for each girl)
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Adnil, Zarleen, Naandeen, Midori
Adnil quietly checks that she has all of her books.
She looks far more serious than usual.
Zarleen adjusts the strap on her satchel.
Naandeen closes her notebook one final time.
Midori watches them.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Quiet final procession toward examinations; use wide closing panel for anticipation. Do not show examination outcomes or add a chapter title/folio.

scenes.heading: Scene 3
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Zarleen, Naandeen, Adnil, Midori
The four girls step into the Academy corridor.
Students from several Academy levels walk toward the examination grounds. All levels take examinations during the same period; many foundational examinations are shared.
The usual morning conversations are absent.
Only quiet footsteps fill the hallway.
No dialogue.
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Quiet final procession toward examinations; use wide closing panel for anticipation. Do not show examination outcomes or add a chapter title/folio.

scenes.heading: Scene 4
scenes.script:
Setting:
Blocking: Midori, Adnil, Naandeen, Zarleen
Midori looks around at the unusually quiet students.
She leans toward Adnil.
(Midori: "IS IT NORMAL..."
-> "...FOR EVERYONE TO BE THIS FRIGHTENED?")
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Quiet final procession toward examinations; use wide closing panel for anticipation. Do not show examination outcomes or add a chapter title/folio.
dialogue:
(Midori: "IS IT NORMAL..."
-> "...FOR EVERYONE TO BE THIS FRIGHTENED?")

scenes.heading: Scene 5
scenes.script:
Setting:
Close on Adnil.
Adnil looks straight ahead.
She manages a small smile.
(Adnil: "ASK ME AGAIN TOMORROW.")
scenes.direction: DIRECTORIAL PLAN (PRODUCTION ONLY): Direction: Quiet final procession toward examinations; use wide closing panel for anticipation. Do not show examination outcomes or add a chapter title/folio.
dialogue: (Adnil: "ASK ME AGAIN TOMORROW.")

scenes.heading: Scene 6
scenes.script:
DIRECTORIAL SCENE NOTE (PRODUCTION ONLY): Camera: Wide quiet final image, leave visual breathing room and no extra lettering.
Setting: Naandeen offers her dry comment as the four roommates continue toward the examination grounds.
(Naandeen: "IF WE’RE ALL STILL AWAKE.")
Midori smiles; Adnil laughs; Naandeen remains thoughtful; Zarleen groans. The four continue with the crowd toward the distant examination grounds.
End Chapter 12


SUPPLEMENTAL FEATURE — NOT PART OF CHAPTER 12 STORY
Supplemental pagination: The five Midori’s Guide to Japanese pages follow Story Page 71 as regular consecutive pages 72–76. Page 72 is verso (binding edge RIGHT); Pages 73 and 75 are recto, and Pages 74 and 76 are verso. Apply the corresponding generation-safe areas. The guide remains a distinct supplemental feature, outside Chapter 12 story chronology.
Midori’s Guide to Japanese — Episode 1: Chopsticks
